title: DAMA-DMBOK
summary: DAMA Data Management Body of Knowledge — an industry body of knowledge describing data management knowledge areas, including data architecture, modeling, governance, quality and metadata.
body_markdown:
# DAMA-DMBOK

## Scope

Body of knowledge (not a formal standard) organised in knowledge areas with data governance at the centre.

## Requirements

Not normative. Provides definitions, activities, roles and deliverables per knowledge area.

## Applicability

Reference for terminology and scope of this knowledge base's domains.

## Related Architecture Concepts

[[Data Governance]], [[Data Architecture]], [[Data Quality]], [[Metadata]].

## Related Controls

None.
